label: Player (Grayson)
flavor: The player-character. Weathered freelancer pilot; dry, defiant, a little tired. Used for every Grayson line.

label: Confed male — clipped military
flavor: Cold authority. Confed comms, Admiral Terrell, Lynch. The default fallback voice for unknown characters.

label: Merchant female
flavor: Hard, no-nonsense female. Tayla, Murphy, Cross, merchant traffic, Confed female comms.

label: Merchant male — smooth
flavor: Smooth, persuasive trader. Sandoval, male merchant traffic.

label: Retro male — prim zealot
flavor: Prim, academic cadence with a fanatic edge. Masterson, Retro faction comms.

label: Steltek / eccentric male
flavor: Odd, off-kilter delivery. Monkhouse, Steltek-adjacent weirdness.

label: Pirate male — raspy taunt
flavor: Raspy, mocking raider. Pirate hails, the ambush_troy antagonist.

label: Militia male
flavor: Working-class patrol officer; brisk but human. Militia comms.

label: Bounty hunter male
flavor: Flat, unhurried menace. Bounty hunter hails and mercenary work.

label: Kilrathi — guttural
flavor: Deep, growled alien menace. Kilrathi warrior comms.
